_comment: ARX Omni exercise catalog - all 17 exercises of the Omni are mapped (v0.6.2); the ARX Alpha's exercises (Leg Press, Chest Press, Torso Flexion / Extension / Rotation ...) are not, no Alpha data has been available yet. code = ExerciseSet.EXERCISE in DB. Mapping derived by joining the ARX cloud CSV export on date+max+intensity (68/68 matched); v0.6.2: eight more codes (5, 13, 14, 25, 31, 41, 42, 43) from a test user's export joined on the timestamp (9/9 matched, 12 = Triceps Pressdown as the control). group per ARX Push/Pull/Drive. kind: compound | isolation.
_limiters: Optional per exercise. 'targets' = the muscles the exercise is FOR; 'limiters' = structures that tend to give out first although they are only a means (e.g. the grip on a Dead Lift). Several exercises sharing a limiter fatigue it cumulatively within a session, and an exercise whose TARGET is another exercise's LIMITER belongs after it in the plan. Vocabulary: grip, elbow_flexors (biceps/brachialis), triceps, shoulders (anterior deltoid), chest, lats, upper_back, lower_back, glutes, quads, hamstrings, calves. Missing fields are fine - the code treats them as empty.
_joints: Optional per exercise: the body parts a user can flag as limited on the restrictions screen (shoulder, elbow, wrist, knee, hip, lower_back, neck). An exercise listing a flagged joint is eased ('careful') or dropped ('avoid'). Overhead pulling (Pull Down) and rowing load an irritated shoulder too, not only the presses. Exercises without this field fall back to the built-in name map.
_aids: Optional per exercise: aids that take a limiter out of the game (hooks / straps remove the grip). The athlete switches an aid on per exercise in the profile (with the date since when); from then on the grip no longer counts as a limiter of that exercise - in recovery, evidence, order and the limiter budget. The planner suggests an aid where a limiter carries several exercises of one session.
_variants: How an exercise is set up can change its helpers. Calf Raise is entered for the BELT (nothing but the calves limits it). Done with the bar in the hands it hangs on the grip like Shrugs: then give it "limiters": ["grip"], "aids": ["hooks", "straps"] and add wrist + lower_back to its joints. High Pull and Pec Fly hold the elbow under tension (v0.7.0: elbow added to their joints).
_library_note: _library = ARX exercises whose DB code is not known yet (nobody in the mapped database has performed them). The planner may suggest ONE of them per session - flagged as new, sub-maximal, without a target number - when a muscle has had no direct work for 4 weeks (or never) or a region is set to 'more'. Once the code is known, move the entry up with its code as the key. Empty since v0.6.2: every exercise of the ARX app known so far has its code.
